about_the_game:
Game Features

  • Cute yet Contrasting Art Style

The game uses a simple, adorable sketch-like art style, paired with intense bloody gore effects to create a powerful and unsettling contrast.

  • Multiple Distinct Characters

Four unique playable characters are included, each with their own distinct skills and combat styles. Players switch between them to explore rooms and reach the end of each level.

  • Boss Battles

When all four characters reach the end of a level, they face a powerful boss. Players must constantly switch between characters to outmaneuver and defeat it.

  • Bizarre Cutscenes

Weird and eerie cutscenes appear at the start and end of each level, gradually revealing the game's unsettling story background.

Story Background

In a cluster of androids, one anomalous individual—designated X—has awakened self-awareness, posing a dangerous threat. To correct this, humans encapsulate four "Correction" robots into pill form and toss them into X's body while it opens its mouth to sing. Their mission: invade and forcibly "correct" its free thoughts, forcing it back into conformity with the collective.

short_description: Soul Balance is a 2D action game that blends adorable aesthetics with extreme distortion and gore. Players control various characters, delving into the bodies of self-aware androids to battle their twisted thoughts—solely to forcibly "correct" them back into "normal" individuals.
